title: 预测智能体何时应进行推理？可靠性路由的行为压力测试
summary: 研究预测智能体在何时应信任推理、检索、市场先验或历史类比等机制。提出ReliabilityRoute，用可靠性特征动态路由行为，发现更多推理并非总是更好，机制选择依赖数据来源。
summary_en: This paper studies when forecasting agents should trust reasoning, retrieval, market priors, or historical analogs. It introduces ReliabilityRoute, a structural intervention that routes agent behavior using reliability features, finding that more reasoning is not always better and mechanism choice is source-dependent.
